From “financial freedom” seminars to flashy cars on Instagram, MLM scams are spreading like wildfire in India. They promise easy money, passive income, and early retirement—but behind the motivation talks lies a classic pyramid scheme where only the people at the top win.

Ordinary Indians are pushed to recruit friends, relatives, even parents—until the system collapses and most are left broke, ashamed, and silent. These scams thrive on desperation, unemployment, and fake success stories.

In this video, we expose how MLM scams actually work, why they’re legal loopholes, and how millions are being fooled in the name of entrepreneurship.
